_comment: Accepted runtime-reachable advisories for scripts/dep-risk-check.mjs. Each entry needs a `ghsa` (the advisory id, e.g. GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx) and a `reason` recording the judgement that the vulnerable path is not reachable in this project's use of the dependency, and who made it. An entry that matches no current advisory FAILS the check, so an acceptance cannot outlive the advisory it accepted — when the dependency is patched, remove the entry. It is intentionally EMPTY: every current advisory is dev-only-reachable, so nothing needs accepting, and an empty list is the only honest state for that.
